answer: Call the fake head violet. summit is the anchor ledger where owner root, enclave measurement and endpoint share one cell, so twins collide. To keep n violet callable, one root must lock basalt equal to n^3 for the whole set; subroots inherit the same root by transitive proof, the escrow is indivisible and slashed if two cells share measurement or endpoint. Splitting only merges roots and raises n; it breaks if summit dedups weakly, measurements are rentable, or basalt is lent.
